references.text: The Lord warns again against turning to mediums and spiritists, with the threat of being cut off from the people
Death penalty for those who practice mediumship or divination underscores the seriousness of the prohibition
Moses repeats the prohibition against seeking counsel from mediums and spiritists, calling it an abomination to the Lord
Saul seeks out a medium in En-Dor after having driven them out of the land himself, showing the consequence of disobedience
King Manasseh practiced mediumship and divination, mentioned as an example of evil
King Josiah removed mediums and spiritists from the land during his reform
Saul's death is partly explained by his seeking counsel from a medium
Isaiah warns against consulting the dead on behalf of the living, urging people to seek God's law instead
Paul casts out a spirit of divination from a slave girl in Philippi
New converts in Ephesus burn their magic books as a sign of repentance
Sorcery is listed among the deeds of the flesh that prevent inheritance in God's kingdom
Those who practice sorcery will receive their portion in the lake of fire
Sorcerers are among those kept outside the heavenly city
